caseName: Mississippi River Transmission Corp. v. Simonton
caseNameFull: Mississippi River Transmission Corp. v. Simonton, Sheriff and Ex-Officio Tax Collector, Lincoln Parish, Louisiana

opinions.text: Appeal from Ct. App. La., 2d Cir., dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari denied.
